name: missa-launch-video
description: Missa launch video, built with Remotion. Standalone: not part of the npm workspaces.

scripts.studio: npm run sync && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:square: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts LaunchSquare out/missa-launch-1080x1080.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts LaunchVertical out/missa-launch-1080x1920.mp4
scripts.render:wide: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts LaunchWide out/missa-launch-1920x1080.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:square && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:wide && npm run render:cuts
scripts.render:cuts: npm run sync && for c in Cut15Square Cut15Vertical Cut15Wide Cut6Square Cut6Vertical Cut6Wide; do remotion render src/index.ts $c out/missa-$c.mp4 || exit 1; done
